Meta.title: Mateus Winter — Full-stack Developer
Meta.description: Full-stack developer with a front-end and UI/UX focus. I build web and mobile products in React, Next.js, React Native and Laravel — tested end to end.

Hero.intro: I build web and mobile products end to end in React, Next.js, React Native and Laravel — polished on the surface, tested underneath.
Hero.stackSr: Stack: Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, React Native, Laravel/Node.js, Figma and Git.

About.label: About me
About.lead: I'm Mateus, a full-stack developer & UI/UX designer. For over five years, I've been turning complex products into uncomplicated interfaces.
About.body: I started out building websites, moved into front-end and UI/UX, and today I work across the whole stack: React and Next.js, React Native and Expo, Laravel and PostgreSQL. I care about the details users notice — and the ones they never should: loading states, accessibility, a map that doesn't stutter.
About.ai: With Claude Code in my daily work, my job has become more engineering and less typing: I design the architecture, anticipate the edge cases, review every diff and validate everything with tests.
